changelog: - **The first-run tour matches the layout on a phone held sideways.** Start tour on the Welcome card chose the phone or the desktop tour by the window's width alone, while the layout also counts a phone turned sideways as a phone. A phone held sideways got the desktop tour on the phone layout, with five of its six steps pointing at nothing; a desktop window 721 to 767 pixels wide got the phone tour. The tour now uses the layout's own rule.
